text.text_excerpt: You'll miss this place if you're not looking for it, I certainly had no idea they'd been there for so long (more than a year at the time of this yelping) when I first noticed them. I can only attest for the smoothies but they're GREAT. Not Jamba Juice great, mind you, for that is a level of greatness unparalleled by most things. I daresay they may give them a run for their money, however. They're all cutely named after kitschy aspects of local culture. My favorite is the Basin Street Blues, a blend of dark berries that's intensely flavorful without being too sweet.

I love Lemonade Parade! What's better than a cool, freshly squeezed beverage on a hot day in the neighborhood!? I love the simplicity of their plain iced lemonade, it usually never lasts the 3 blocks back to my house-- it's that good! They also have a wonderful selection of fun coffee drinks and smoothies named after New Orleans songs and events. Let me just say all in all, darn cute and tasty!

For a place called lemonade Parade, they sure do have some bomb ass hot tamales! Go get some, they are as good as Fat Mama's in Natchez. I just wish they'd sell Knock you nekkid margaritas like at Fat Mama's instead of those non-alcoholic drinks. Fresh squeezed lemonade, strawberry lemonade, smoothies and tamales. Yup. Oh, and maybe they have the liquid crack fake cheese Nachos too. I swear I recall a poster saying, "try our crack cheese nachos". But nope, crack is whack, Bobby. I usually come here after my big weekly grocery store trip from the Rouses, for a little treat after hauling home 45 freakin bags of groceries. Crack cheese isn't ment to be eating while you are driving down Carro...
